notes.title: Now Available For Free
notes.content: This VR game is now available for free.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content: All levels and enemies have been significantly updated. A number of graphical improvements have been made, as well as improved enemy physics. All leaderboards have been reset to reflect the changes in gameplay.

notes.title: Graphics Updated
notes.content: The graphics have now been updated and the leaderboards have been reset to account for changes made to the gameplay.

notes.title: Graphics being updated.
notes.content: The game is currently having its graphics updated, so that all the models are fully textured as opposed to the look it has at the moment. This will take some time and should be finished by December.

notes.title: New Mountains Environment
notes.content: A new 'Mountains' environment has been added to the game.

notes.title: New Woods Environment
notes.content: A new 'Woods' environment has been added to the game.
